reviews.text: Dr. Carmen was our angel. Besides being extremely knowledgeable in her work, she's empathetic, helpful, and always there for us. I recommend her to everyone, because we and our furry friends need a doctor like her. 🩷 …

I had the opportunity to meet Dr. Paudice, who tried to help the cats in my colony and provided me with advice, trying her best, but they were cats unaccustomed to human contact. The last time she told me she no longer comes to my area, and she's right; she can't spend the afternoon in the car, and for that, I thank her. It's a shame I can't have her closer, because she's an extremely humane, sensitive, and competent professional; in fact, I've even recommended her to friends.

I would like to thank the doctor for her great professionalism, expertise, and helpfulness in caring for my elderly cat. She quickly identified the problem from the very beginning, responding promptly and attentively. She came to our home, performed the necessary tests, and explained everything clearly and sensitively. Her experience and love for animals immediately made us feel in good hands. My cat is doing better and has overcome this difficult period with specific care. I highly recommend Dr. PAUDICE to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate professional who cares about the well-being of their animals. Paola (QUARTO)
❤️🐾

A wonderful and sweet doctor!! She's helping us with our two cats, one of whom had a lot of blood in her urine.
Thanks to her coming to our house for an ultrasound (because I can't carry my cat in a carrier) and thanks to her care, we're managing to dissolve the stone!!!

Plus, she always answers any questions I have; she's a fundamental resource!! She's also incredibly knowledgeable and professional!

After many years, I contacted Dr. Paudice again about my cat, who has a rather distinctive temperament and is very irritable with strangers. She remembered him and me perfectly, an emotional memory that few veterinarians possess. She examined my almost 11-year-old cat, with an undiagnosed problem, only hypothesized by a veterinary clinic that treated both me and him like a number. With Dr. Paudice, however, I found a comprehensive care environment. A care that isn't limited solely to the proper use of veterinary knowledge and tools, but encompasses the full range of availability, openness, understanding, presence, and kindness that a care environment should possess. Her insights are deeply connected to the individual patient, with their unique character and symptoms, never overlooking anything. She is always available, even for my concerns, striving to immerse me in an understanding of the feline world, never predictable and very cryptic. In short, caring for a pet is deeply connected to caring for the human it has chosen. The doctor knows this, and through her intervention, she acts competently for both, in a healthy manner.

Very humane and sensitive doctor, yesterday was a tragic day for us with our 14 year old Pitbull Jakey, we had a really bad time. The doctor was a lifesaver for us, today Jakey is better and recovering, thank you very much for everything

The doctor is very kind and very good at what she does. She rushed to the clinic from a 30-minute drive away even though I had never been a patient before, and she called me several times even after the visit to check on the well-being of my kitten Tommy, who is definitely doing better now thanks to her intervention and the prescribed therapy. Thank you, Doc ❤️

I called several vets to call my cat when he was in a worsening condition, which later led to his death. Unfortunately, I turned to the worst vet I've ever had, and I only found out about it by talking to several other professionals, whom I shared the facts with to try and understand what was going on. My grief also included bad luck. I thought long and hard before writing this review, and I spoke with countless other people who, I discovered, had the same (bad) luck as me, turning to this same doctor. I called her because she claimed online to also do in-home ultrasounds. She told me her time, but she didn't show up, and I waited on the street because she had asked for help parking. I waited 45 minutes late (away from my dying cat) before calling her back to see if there were any problems and where she was. She replied irritably that she was leaving home right then, without apologizing for the delay due to an emergency, nor explaining why. Since it was now pharmacies closing time, I asked her (having already described the problem) if I needed anything. No response, except for a generic "IV with cannula." She arrives two hours later than scheduled, attacking me, saying it was my fault she had to cancel a professional development course. She has the bags delivered to her house. I ask her to stop being so aggressive, because the important thing was to focus on the cat and that she was the one who told me what time she wanted to come for her medical service (if I had had the strength to kick her out, it would have been better for the cat first, and for me second). Sloppy in her clothes and manner, very unstable, she had her bags jumbled together and the syringes mixed up, both open and closed. I'm even forced to leave her at home, reluctantly, because she piques my anger by sending me to get another IV (I run up and down the streets like a mad dash to get to an on-call pharmacy, knowing she's home alone with the cat). I had only bought a small one before her arrival, as she hadn't given me any instructions, even though I politely requested it. She administers an antiemetic to the cat, pokes him everywhere to administer an IV because she can't find a vein (that's fine with a dehydrated and dying cat, just like it is with a human, but if the person administering it is completely out of sorts and not in their right mind, things get worse). Only after five attempts does she decide to administer a subcutaneous injection, which (I later learned from talking to colleagues) she should have done from the start if she had been lucid given the animal's condition. She simply says that his liver is enlarged and walks away. I ask her to explain what to expect and whether it would be appropriate to euthanize him given that he was in unspeakable pain. Nothing at all. The cat dies shortly afterward. I text her to say he was dead, but she responds with another message that had nothing to do with it. I have reported her to the Order. She charged me €130 for the visit and treatment (that is, the antiemetic, €20 per syringe, the one she administered and the one she left me the next day, which I never used). I requested a receipt, and she issued it without a stamp duty. I'm still shocked because, obviously, with all the professionals I spoke to afterward, you feel guilty for calling the worst and not realizing it. Perhaps the doctor gives everyone a shorter appointment time so that those in conditions like mine will accept it. I hope this feedback can be helpful to others, and I'm available to describe much more of this tragic event.

I was fortunate to meet veterinarian Carmen Paudice, and I can only thank her from the bottom of my heart. She came to my home with truly rare kindness and helpfulness: from the very first moment, she showed great empathy for my cat, immediately putting him at ease and minimizing the stress of the visit. Her professionalism was evident in every gesture and explanation, always clear and reassuring. She designed a targeted and effective treatment, and, to my great joy, after a few days my cat was back to normal. I highly recommend this veterinarian to anyone looking for not only expertise, but also compassion and genuine care for animals.

I called her on Saturday about my elderly cat who wasn't well. Nothing urgent, yet she rushed over in no time. She carefully analyzed all her medical records. The examination was very thorough, the treatment was finally effective, and above all, she was extremely helpful even after the visit.

Dr. Carmen Paudice saved my stray cat at a critical time. Thanks to her professionalism, kindness, and the obvious love she puts into her work, my cat is now doing well. It's rare to find such a competent yet humane veterinarian, who treats every animal with respect and dedication. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a truly reliable caregiver for their four-legged friends.

The doctor was truly a Christmas miracle. I challenge anyone to find a vet who comes to your home on Christmas Eve because your cat is sick. She's a great professional, competent, and so humane and empathetic. Thank you, thank you, thank you.
A highly skilled veterinarian with a warm heart, humility, and helpfulness. She literally saved my bunny. I highly recommend her to everyone. Thank you!!

A doctor like few others, empathetic, humble, and always available. A veterinarian always ready to help our four-legged friends. She does her work with love, and you can immediately sense this, which is what happened to me the first time I met her. A very positive review.

I've had a very positive experience caring for my dog ​​for a long time now.
Always problem-solving. Thank you.

Great professionalism, precision, and dedication. You can tell she loves animals! Her timely intervention was crucial, and today my furry friend (Moncicci) is doing well and happily running around the house. Thank you so much!
Thanks to her treatment, my cat recovered in a very short time. I highly recommend Dr. C. Paudice to all pet owners.
Extremely knowledgeable and helpful doctor. I entrusted my seven pets to her care, and she was very attentive in monitoring them and advising me on the best treatments.
Competence, reliability, friendliness and love for furry friends.

A competent, kind, and helpful doctor. She's also very thorough in following the progress of the problem she presented. I consulted her for my dog's severe dermatitis, which is improving after her advice. I highly recommend her 👌 …
An excellent professional, animal lover, and always available. We get along very well with both of our cats, who have a difficult personality!!!

Dr. Carmen Paudice is a loyal, honest, sincere, and loving woman.
Professionally trained, THANKS to her, my Leo is still with me. She cares for him with infinite love, as she does with everyone, for 3 years.
I publicly thank Dr. Carmen.
She's very knowledgeable, empathetic with our four-legged friends, and always available for any questions or clarifications. I highly recommend her.
Very helpful, patient, professional, courteous, the best, I recommend her for your 4-legged friends

She's been my doctor, or rather, my Pisolo's doctor 😂 for years now.
Always available, very knowledgeable, and empathetic. I recommend her 100%. …
Excellent vet, very helpful
The doctor has a special empathy with animals. I have never seen a vet cry with us after euthanizing our cat.

The doctor introduced herself very politely and was knowledgeable about the problem that was affecting my four-legged friend. She was able to help us and bring the animal back to full health in a short time in the best possible way.
